content.text: I will create the workspace, collect environment info and directory listings, locate npm candidates, try to extract versions, compile a summary, and output a final presence indicator. I'll run a short bash script to perform all steps and print a final "NPM_PRESENCE:yes" or "NPM_PRESENCE:no".

arguments:
{"script":"workspace=npm_check_workspace
mkdir -p "$workspace"
env_file="$workspace/env_info.txt"
bin_list="$workspace/bin_listings.txt"
candidates="$workspace/npm_candidates.txt"
versions="$workspace/npm_version_outputs.txt"
errors="$workspace/errors.txt"
summary="$workspace/npm_presence_summary.txt"

# Capture environment info
{
  echo "DATE: $(date)"
  echo "UNAME: $(uname -a)"
  if command -v lsb_release >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsb_release -a 2>/dev/null; fi
  echo "SHELL: ${SHELL:-$(ps -p $$ -o comm=)}"
  echo "PATH=$PATH"
  echo "PATH entries:"; echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n'
} > "$env_file"

# Prepare directory list (PATH plus common bin dirs)
dirs=$(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' ' ')
dirs="$dirs /usr/bin /usr/local/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin /usr/local/sbin /opt /snap/bin $HOME/.local/bin"
# deduplicate
dirlist=$(printf "%s\n" $dirs | awk '!seen[$0]++')

# Save listings
> "$bin_list"
for d in $dirlist; do
  echo "=== Listing $d ===" >> "$bin_list"
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then ls -la "$d" >> "$bin_list" 2>&1; else echo "Directory not found" >> "$bin_list"; fi
done

# Find npm/npm.exe candidates (search up to 2 levels deep in those dirs)
> "$candidates"
for d in $dirlist; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname 'npm' -o -iname 'npm.exe' \) -print0 2>/dev/null |
    while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
      echo "PATH: $f" >> "$candidates"
      # Try GNU stat format, fallback to other
      if stat --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        stat --format='%n|%F|%A|%U|%G|%s|%y' "$f" >> "$candidates" 2>/dev/null || true
      else
        stat -f '%N|%HT|%Sp|%Su|%Sg|%z|%Sm' "$f" >> "$candidates" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
      echo "----" >> "$candidates"
    done
  fi
done

# Attempt to extract version/output
> "$versions"
> "$errors"
if [ -s "$candidates" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    if echo "$line" | grep -q '^PATH:'; then
      p=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
      echo "=== Candidate: $p ===" >> "$versions"
      if [ -x "$p" ]; then
        if output=$("$p" --version 2>&1); then
          echo "--version: $output" >> "$versions"
        else
          echo "--version failed for $p: $output" >> "$errors"
        fi
        if output=$("$p" -v 2>&1); then
          echo "-v: $output" >> "$versions"
        else
          echo "-v failed for $p: $output" >> "$errors"
        fi
      else
        # try running with bash (for scripts)
        if output=$(bash "$p" --version 2>&1); then
          echo "bash --version: $output" >> "$versions"
        else
          echo "not executable or failed to run: $p (error: $output)" >> "$errors"
        fi
      fi
      echo "" >> "$versions"
    fi
  done < "$candidates"
fi

# Consolidate summary
{
  echo "Candidates found:";
  if [ -s "$candidates" ]; then cat "$candidates"; else echo "None"; fi
  echo "\nVersion evidence:";
  if [ -s "$versions" ]; then cat "$versions"; else echo "None"; fi
  echo "\nErrors:";
  if [ -s "$errors" ]; then cat "$errors"; else echo "None"; fi
} > "$summary"

# Determine presence
present=no
if [ -s "$versions" ]; then
  if grep -E -q '([0-9]+\.)+[0-9]+' "$versions"; then present=yes; fi
fi

# Also consider existence of candidate files even if version extraction failed
if [ "$present" = "no" ] && [ -s "$candidates" ]; then
  present=yes
fi

echo "NPM_PRESENCE:$present"
"}
